releaseNotes: Zuriel 2.10.8: restores the seven-item navigation, improves narrow-screen Bible search, separates Read and Study, and protects Open Book export navigation. Complete 66-book KJV remains available offline. Live online passage retrieval verified for AMP, TPT, NLT, NET, NIV, NASB and NKJV. GNT, Living Bible, ESV and CSB remain unavailable pending publisher/account access. Gallery saving still requires confirmation on a physical Android device.
